name: transcripted
description: A Mac companion for Transcripted: retrieve saved context, control meetings, and share on-device live meeting text with ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect to Transcripted on this Mac. Find saved meetings, dictations, and writing; start and stop a meeting; and follow provisional text produced by the Mac's on-device speech model. Recording controls and live sharing require explicit access in Transcripted. Audio stays on the Mac. Text you choose to share is sent to ChatGPT. Requires the companion-enabled Transcripted app and a local-capable desktop host.
defaultPrompt: Open Transcripted and show my recent context.
Use Transcripted to find what I committed to this week, with sources.
Open the Transcripted companion so I can record a meeting and share live text.
